name: World Clock
description: The current time, here or somewhere else
complete-description:
Shows the current time, either this machine's own, or a place you choose, independently per tile. Run two instances side by side to track two different timezones at once.

No format choices here (12-hour vs 24-hour, whether to show seconds or a date) that's entirely up to whichever theme is displaying it. This module only ever answers one question: what time is it, and in which timezone.
